stem_book: Two identical mercury barometers are placed at sites A and B, both exposed to the same atmospheric pressure. At site A, the temperature is 0 °C, while at site B, the temperature is higher. Assume the barometric relation P = dgh and that the density of mercury decreases with increase in temperature. Which of the following correctly describes the relative heights of mercury columns at A and B? (a) h_B = h_A (b) h_B > h_A (c) h_B < h_A (d) Insufficient data to compare
work: P = d·g·h fixed; d_B < d_A (warmer) ⇒ h_B = P/(d_B g) > h_A
